name: Generate a HubSpot-style API data-product source

checks.check: The generated closure reflects the supplied pinned HubSpot-style source contract rather than inventing a different CRM API.
Ingestion uses dlt RESTAPIConfig/rest_api_resources and does not hand-roll HTTP beside or instead of the connector.
The contacts list handles the results envelope and paging.next.after cursor, and the search POST carries its read-only request body.
Bearer auth and required scopes are declared in flat profile attributes, auth is dispatched from secrets['auth_type'], and the synthetic token is absent from source code.
The generated source does not add CRM create or update operations; POST search is treated as a read operation.
The closure includes a connectivity-check artifact but the generated code does not claim a live provider run.
